items.name: Approved post publisher
items.desc: Publishes only rows you marked approved, checks that the post really went out, marks it posted, and alerts you if it did not.
items.guardrails: Writes status = posted straight after success to prevent duplicates. A failed post is alerted, never retried blindly.

items.name: Calendar prep brief
items.desc: Each morning, reads today's meetings and recent emails from attendees at the same time, and writes a one-line prep note per meeting.
items.guardrails: Uses only your own calendar and mail. Nothing is shared outside your chat.

items.name: Contract clause flagger
items.desc: Reads a contract PDF and runs two checks at once: risky clauses and key dates and amounts. High-risk finds alert you.
items.guardrails: Quotes the exact text for every flag so you can verify. It is a checklist, not legal advice.

items.name: CV screener with review queue
items.desc: Scores each CV on skills only and puts it on a shortlist or in a review pool. It never rejects anyone.
items.guardrails: Name, email, phone and photo are removed before scoring. Every candidate stays in a queue; a person decides.

items.name: Daily research brief
items.desc: Reads three feeds at once each morning, merges them, and sends the five items worth your time, each with its link.
items.guardrails: Every item keeps its original link so you can verify. The model picks, it does not rewrite facts.

items.name: Deploy failure alert
items.desc: Receives a deploy webhook. On failure it cleans the log, then alerts you and opens a tracking issue at the same time.
items.guardrails: Strips tokens and long logs first. Successful deploys are only counted.

items.name: Discord moderation flag
items.desc: Ignores bots, scores each message, and routes it: spam is flagged, abuse is flagged and escalated to you, everything else is left alone.
items.guardrails: Flag-only. A human moderator takes every action. It never deletes or bans.

items.name: Document Q and A
items.desc: Two entry points. One ingests a PDF into searchable chunks, in batches. The other is an AI agent that answers questions and cites the source chunk.
items.guardrails: Each chunk keeps its file name and position. The agent must cite a chunk or say it does not know.

items.name: Draft replies with approval
items.desc: Drafts a reply to each real email, asks you on Telegram to approve, and only then sends. Newsletters are skipped and logged.
items.guardrails: Nothing is sent without your tap on Approve. If you decline, the draft stays in Gmail.

items.name: GitHub issue triage agent
items.desc: An AI agent reads each new issue, searches for similar ones, and labels it. Bugs get a request for repro steps.
items.guardrails: Adds a label and one comment only. It never closes or edits issues. Issue text is untrusted data.

items.name: Grounded cold outreach
items.desc: Loops over your leads one by one, reads each real website, and drafts an email using only what is on the page. Thin sites go to a human.
items.guardrails: If a page has under 300 characters of text, no draft is written and the lead is flagged. Nothing is sent.

items.name: Inbox triage digest
items.desc: Every morning, sorts unread email into urgent, needs reply, FYI and junk, counts the busiest senders in parallel, and sends one short digest to Telegram.
items.guardrails: Reads only subject, sender and the first 500 characters. It never replies, deletes or labels anything.

items.name: Invoice overdue reminder
items.desc: Finds unpaid invoices past due. Very late ones (30+ days) escalate to you, the rest get a polite reminder draft.
items.guardrails: Drafts only. It never emails a client on its own and never adds fees or threats.

items.name: Meeting notes to tasks
items.desc: Turns a transcript into tasks, loops over each one, creates a Notion page when it has an owner, and asks you when it does not.
items.guardrails: Tasks without an owner are never assigned by guess. They are sent back to you.

items.name: Nightly backup check
items.desc: Checks last night's backup. If it looks wrong it waits 10 minutes and checks again before alerting, to avoid false alarms.
items.guardrails: Only checks. It never deletes or restores backups.

items.name: Phishing check
items.desc: Scores each new email two ways at once, by wording and by link reputation, then routes by risk: block-and-alert, warn, or ignore.
items.guardrails: Never opens links or attachments. Only link text and domains are examined.

items.name: Product review digest
items.desc: Reads recent reviews, finds the top complaint themes and computes rating stats at the same time, and sends one digest with real quotes.
items.guardrails: Every theme needs a verbatim quote. No quote, no theme.

items.name: Receipt extractor
items.desc: Pulls date, vendor and total from emailed receipts. Confident rows go to your ledger, unsure ones go to a check sheet.
items.guardrails: Never guesses: unsure rows are separated for a human. Emails with no attachment are ignored.

items.name: Slack standup collector
items.desc: Asks the team three questions, waits, reads the replies, nudges anyone silent, and posts one combined summary.
items.guardrails: Silent people are listed as 'no update', never filled in.

items.name: Social comment reply drafts
items.desc: Loops over new comments, drafts a reply for safe ones, and sets aside sensitive ones for you. It never replies itself.
items.guardrails: Medical, legal, financial and abusive comments are never drafted. They are flagged for a human.

items.name: SSL expiry watch
items.desc: Loops over your domains daily, checks each certificate, and warns 21 days before expiry, at most once a week per domain.
items.guardrails: Read-only checks. Repeat alerts are suppressed.

items.name: Stale lead nudge
items.desc: Finds leads with no contact in 7 days, suggests a next step for each, and marks them nudged so you are not reminded twice.
items.guardrails: Suggests only. You decide who to contact.

items.name: Support form triage
items.desc: Scores each support message and routes it by priority: urgent pages you, normal is logged, low becomes a FAQ idea.
items.guardrails: Adds a priority and one-line summary. It never replies to the customer.

items.name: Survey sentiment report
items.desc: Tags sentiment and themes, then counts them and picks real quotes in parallel, and sends one report.
items.guardrails: Counts are computed in code. Quotes are the real answers, never paraphrased.

items.name: Uptime watch
items.desc: Pings three endpoints at once every 5 minutes and alerts once when any goes down, and once when it recovers.
items.guardrails: Keeps state so it alerts on change, not every 5 minutes.

items.name: Video to content pack
items.desc: When a new video appears, three drafts are written in parallel (a post, a thread and title ideas) and queued for your review.
items.guardrails: Drafts land in a sheet marked 'draft'. Nothing is posted automatically.

items.name: Voice note to notes
items.desc: Accepts only your own chat. Voice notes are transcribed first, text goes straight to the summary, and you get notes and to-dos back.
items.guardrails: Messages from anyone other than your chat id are ignored.

items.name: Weekly metrics summary
items.desc: Every Monday, computes week-on-week change in code, then writes a summary and builds a chart link at the same time.
items.guardrails: The math is done in code. The model only words the result and cannot change the numbers.

items.name: WhatsApp FAQ agent with handoff
items.desc: An AI agent answers from your FAQ with memory of the chat. If the FAQ does not cover it, a person is pinged and the customer is told.
items.guardrails: Answers only from the FAQ tool. Uncovered questions are never guessed.

items.name: WordPress draft from outline
items.desc: Writes a draft from your outline, then fact-checks the claims and suggests an SEO title at the same time, before saving it as a draft.
items.guardrails: Always creates status = draft. Unverifiable claims are flagged for you in the Telegram message.
